description: Fetch the fully rendered HTML of any public web page through the ScrapeUnblocker API (https://docs.scrapeunblocker.com). The page loads in a real browser, so JavaScript-rendered pages come back complete. Use it when you need the page markup, or when a plain HTTP fetch returns 403/429 or an empty page. Returns raw HTML.

proxy_country.description: Optional ISO country code to route through, e.g. 'US'.

sleep_seconds.description: Extra seconds to wait after load.

name: fetch_html
title: Fetch page HTML
